notes.title: Lost Shadows: February Playtest
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 👋

Thank you all for over 4000 wishlists already! We love you all. Thanks for the support, it means a lot to us.

Now, the important part, we're announcing an open playtest in February! 🎉 This is your chance to jump in, conduct research, have fun (or horror) in procedural mines, and get back alive.

As this is our first playtest, we're going to open access partially so that most of bugs won't be directed to you all and it's a chance for us to tweak mechanics and gather feedback gradually and improve the game together with you (or at least try to make it fun 😅). If you see that the playtest button isn't there, just add the game to wishlist and follow our updates, we'll be hosting playtests at least monthly so that the game is smooth by the time we release it.

And few gameplay screenshots for you below to feel atmosphere that awaits you! 👇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219012/3a5d8a3a8db57bf68686a15b38977211ede37c48.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219012/7e3f9fe39c5cfad837422f5d42fb103df381452b.jpg[/img]

So, mark your calendars for February and stay tuned for more details !

Oh, and don’t forget to wishlist if you haven’t yet. (Did we mention that already? Maybe just one more time for good luck 😉.)

Better yet, join our Discord to get all the latest updates, meet other players, and share your thoughts.

See you soon in underground mines!
VowelA Games Team
